noteRo: Interest rate by components (README §4, step 6): rate = index + margin; margin = funding cost + PD × LGD × (1 − g) + RW_effective × capital ratio × cost of capital + operating cost + target profit. The risk and cost parameters are illustrative; the index is the real EURIBOR fixing, and the green funding advantage is the one found in studies (−0.10 pp). The bank puts its real parameters here. Green adjustments are added to the margin (negative = lower interest rate). The EIF guarantee percentage (g) comes from funds.json (F1). Mortgage costs (valuation, notary, registration, insurance) stay with the financing lines in financing-lines.json: collateralUpfrontEur and collateralAnnualEur.

index.name: EURIBOR_3M
index.sourceRo: EURIBOR 3M (EMMI), fixing of 27.10.2026 (euribor-rates.eu); updated with the fixing on the day of the analysis (README §13: currency EUR, index EURIBOR 3M)

fundingCostPct.sourceRo: Illustrative: the bank's funding cost above the index, chosen together with the operating cost and the profit so that the classic rate is 8.90% (README §4, step 6)

pdPct.sourceRo: README §4, step 6: PD 3% on the classic credit (illustrative)

operationalCostPct.sourceRo: Illustrative: technical analysis and manual handling of the dossier; chosen so that the classic rate is 8.90%

targetProfitPct.sourceRo: Illustrative: the target profit that brings the classic rate to 8.90% (2.00 + 1.20 + 1.35 + 1.08 + 1.50 + 1.77)

pdPct.sourceRo: README §4, step 6: PD 3% → 2.5%, because the savings increase the money available for the instalment (better DSCR)

fundingCostAdjustmentPp.sourceRo: Dedicated green funding from the green bonds (F2), −0.10 pp: studies find a greenium of 4–15 basis points in Europe (ABN AMRO 2025, AXA IM, Banque de France); prudent value, to be confirmed with the bank's treasury

operationalCostAdjustmentPp.sourceRo: README §4, step 6: the technical analysis is automated, −0.15 pp

programSubsidyAdjustmentPp.sourceRo: README §4, step 6: programme subsidy or reduced fee (if any), −0.40 pp

impactBonusAdjustmentPp.sourceRo: README §4, step 6: impact bonus, if the actual impact at 12 months confirms the estimate; a product proposal, not an existing Raiffeisen product

lgdPct.sourceRo: README §4, step 6: LGD 45% (illustrative), the same for both credits

riskWeightClientPct.sourceRo: README §4, step 6: RW 75% for the client exposure (standard weight for retail exposures, CRR Art. 123)

riskWeightGuarantorPct.sourceRo: README §4, step 6: the EIF is a multilateral development bank with a 0% risk weight (CRR Art. 117(2))

greenTiers.noteRo: README §4, step 8. Green Plus gets the maximum reduction (all green components); Green and Green with upgrade get the standard reduction; Classic gets the classic rate, without the green components.

verdePlusThresholdMultiplier.sourceRo: README §4, step 8: Green Plus when the indicator exceeds the threshold by ≥ 50% of the threshold (e.g. ≥ 37.5% for a 25% threshold) and DNSH is complete

VERDE_PLUS.sourceRo: README §4, step 8: the maximum interest rate reduction, i.e. all green components

VERDE.sourceRo: Team proposal: the standard reduction is 0.20 pp smaller than for Green Plus; to be confirmed with Raiffeisen

VERDE_CU_UPGRADE.sourceRo: Team proposal: the standard reduction, on the upgraded investment (README §4, step 8); to be confirmed with Raiffeisen

verdePlusMaxExtraCostPct.sourceRo: Team proposal: if a package that reaches Green Plus costs at most 15% more than the cheapest package that passes the threshold, we propose it (README §12: drip + sensors, 40%, instead of drip, 33%); to be confirmed with Raiffeisen
